group.passage: When does your summer break start, and how long does it last? The answer depends on where you go to school. In Europe alone, summer holidays last anywhere from 6 to 14 weeks, with an average of 10 weeks. The table below compares the summer breaks of junior high students in six places. One reason for the difference is the weather. Because Australia lies south of the equator, its summer comes in December and January. In the state of Queensland, the long break includes Christmas, and the new school year begins in late January. In Italy, classes stop in June and do not start again until the middle of September, so students stay home during the hot months of July and August. Even so, the heat is a problem at school. Only 6 percent of Italian schools have air conditioning, and in 2025 some schools in Sicily planned to end lessons at noon during the first days back because of the heat. Another reason is how the rest of the school year is planned. Countries with long summers often give students few breaks during the year. Italy has only one longer break besides summer, while France gives students up to four breaks of two weeks each. So French students have a shorter summer, but they get to rest more often. In Germany, each state picks its own dates, so the school year is staggered: it may begin in early August in one state but not until September in another. A long summer is not good news for every family. Some parents can pay for summer camps or trips that keep children learning, but many others do not have the money. In Italy, more than 76,000 people signed a petition asking to cut the summer break by one month. Others want a change for a different reason: they say a school calendar planned about 50 years ago no longer fits today's hotter climate.

translation_zh.text:
你的暑假什麼時候開始、放多久？答案要看你在哪裡上學。光是在歐洲，暑假就從 6 週到 14 週都有，平均是 10 週。下面的表格比較了六個地方國中生的暑假。
造成差異的原因之一是天氣。澳洲位在赤道以南，所以它的夏天在十二月和一月。在昆士蘭州，這段長假包含了聖誕節，新學年則在一月底開始。在義大利，學校在六月停課，要到九月中才再開學，所以學生在炎熱的七、八月都待在家裡。即使如此，炎熱仍是學校的一大問題。義大利只有百分之 6 的學校有冷氣，2025 年西西里有些學校甚至打算因為炎熱，在開學頭幾天中午就下課。
另一個原因是學年中其他時間怎麼安排。暑假長的國家，學年中的假期往往很少。義大利除了暑假之外只有一次較長的假期，而法國則讓學生在學年中最多有四次、每次兩週的假期。所以法國學生的暑假比較短，但能更常休息。在德國，每一州自己選定日期，所以各地的學年是錯開的：某一州可能八月初就開學，另一州卻要到九月才開學。
長暑假對每個家庭來說不一定都是好消息。有些父母付得起夏令營或旅行的費用，讓孩子在暑假持續學習，但很多父母付不起。在義大利，有超過 76,000 人連署請願，要求把暑假縮短一個月。另一些人則因為不同的理由希望改變：他們認為大約 50 年前規劃的學校行事曆，已經不適合今天更炎熱的氣候。
